expectations.text: Says the book presents the ketogenic diet as a good whole-diet approach for bipolar disorder, ideally under medical supervision, and mentions keto side effects ('keto flu')
expectations.evidence: keto as whole-diet approach, keto flu, supervision

expectations.text: Lists foods to embrace: omega-3 fatty fish, NAC/cysteine-rich foods, folate (B9), magnesium and zinc
States that with lithium sodium intake should be kept constant
Warns that grapefruit juice and tyramine-containing foods (aged cheese, cured meats, soy sauce, etc.) can interfere with some bipolar medications
Advises abstaining from or heavily restricting alcohol and limiting caffeine to under 400 mg/day
Stresses that diet complements but does not replace medication and he should not change meds without his psychiatrist
